name: The Bridge Warden

passives.name: Unyielding
passives.text: Stuns only cost the Warden one action; other ailments last 1 turn less (Omens are not shortened). It cannot be pulled or pushed.

passives.name: Anchored
passives.text: Each standing Iron Mooring gives the Warden +5 armor and +5 magic armor and lets it use Chain Hook. Breaking a Mooring staggers the Warden (it loses its next action) and cancels a pending Breaking Span.

passives.name: Ember Heart
passives.text: At 66% HP the ember wakes: Ash Brand opens and Breaking Span grows to two rows. At 33% the span fails: the Moorings snap, the Warden acts 3 times a turn, hits 15% harder with half its armor, and at once calls the Fall of King's Bridge. A single attack can cross only one of these thresholds.
